sample: 02 · Own-fixture happy path (full lifecycle incl. finalize + withdraw)
cost: 0.02 GEN reward (returned to winner) + 0.0002 GEN bond (returned)
purpose: End-to-end pass on a throwaway repository you control, built in samples/fixture-repo.md. Replace every <YOU> placeholder after following that guide.

openMissionForm.Problem statement: CSV exports corrupt quoted fields that contain embedded newlines: parsing them back loses rows. Repair the parser so embedded LF and CRLF round-trip losslessly without changing the public API.

criteria.text: Quoted CSV fields containing LF round-trip without data loss.
Quoted CSV fields containing CRLF round-trip without data loss.
The public parser function signatures are unchanged.

openMissionForm.Scope policy: Changes may touch src/csv/** and tests/csv/** only.
openMissionForm.Forbidden changes: No dependency replacement, no public API removal, no unrelated refactoring.
openMissionForm.Evidence policy: Only pages under github.com/<YOU>/rivet-fixture count: the candidate commit page and its .diff; CI is not frozen in.

evidence.note: the public defect report this patch answers

challengePanel.when: only while the candidate sits in QUALIFIED_PENDING (30-minute window), from a third account
challengePanel.Claim: A follow-up commit on the same branch shows CRLF handling still fails for empty quoted fields, so criterion C2 is not actually satisfied by the candidate.
challengePanel.expect: The judge compares claims against fetched pages. An honest INCONCLUSIVE refunds your bond; a forced UPHELD requires genuinely defeating evidence.

expectedFlow.artifactExamination: ARTIFACT_VERIFIED on a correctly built fixture.
expectedFlow.criterionReview: QUALIFIED when the patch really fixes LF+CRLF and touches only allowed paths.
expectedFlow.finalize: After the 30-minute window: finalize_submission issues the certificate and credits the winner; verify in #/certificates.
expectedFlow.withdraw: Workbench shows ~0.0202 GEN claimable; withdraw returns it to your wallet.
